select_board.name: Board of Selectmen
select_board.meetingSchedule: 2nd and 4th Monday of each month at 6:00 PM
select_board.notes: Agendas posted 24 hours in advance. Public input welcomed.

planning_board.name: Planning Board
planning_board.meetingSchedule: 3rd Wednesday of each month at 7:00 PM

zoning_board.name: Zoning Board of Adjustment
zoning_board.meetingSchedule: As needed, typically 3rd Thursday at 7:00 PM

town_clerk.name: Town Clerk / Tax Collector
town_clerk.notes: Vehicle registrations, vital records, dog licenses, property tax payments

code_enforcement.name: Code Enforcement / Building Inspector
code_enforcement.notes: Building permits, certificate of occupancy, inspections

trash.schedule: Curbside pickup not available - residents must use transfer station
trash.notes: Some neighborhoods have private trash service - check with your HOA

transferStation.hours: Wednesday 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
transferStation.fees: Resident sticker: $25/year (at Town Clerk). Pay-per-bag for non-residents.
transferStation.notes: Transfer station sticker required. Must show proof of residency to purchase. Hazardous waste collections held twice yearly.

beaches.name: Dan Hole Pond Beach
beaches.fees: Season pass: $75 resident, $150 non-resident. Daily: $10 per car

recreation.notes: Beach passes available at Town Hall. Summer recreation programs for youth - contact Recreation Department for schedule.

taxes.taxRate: Check with Town Clerk for current year rate (varies annually)
paymentMethods: In person at Town Clerk (cash, check, credit/debit with 3% fee)
Mail to: Town of Ossipee, PO Box 67, Center Ossipee, NH 03814
Online via town website (convenience fee applies)
taxes.notes: Interest accrues on unpaid balances after due date. Payment plans available - contact Tax Collector.

voting.registrationInfo: Register to vote at Town Clerk or on election day at polling place. Bring proof of identity and domicile.
voting.absenteeInfo: Absentee ballots available at Town Clerk. Request deadline: 5:00 PM day before election.

building.name: Building Permit
building.description: Required for new construction, additions, decks, sheds >120 sq ft, demolition
building.fee: See Planning Board Fee Schedule (2023) - varies by project type and value
building.notes: State Building Code applies. Inspections required at key milestones.

driveway.name: Driveway Permit
driveway.description: Required for new driveways or changes to existing driveway location/width onto town roads
driveway.notes: Also requires NHDOT permit if connecting to state highway

septic.name: Septic System Permit
septic.description: Required for new or replacement septic systems
septic.notes: State-issued permit. Local Code Enforcement coordinates inspections.

notes: This profile was manually created as a demonstration. Information verified from public sources as of February 2026. Always confirm current details with Town Hall before relying on specific dates, fees, or procedures.
